## Founder

InertialRange Labs AB is an AI and data-platform consulting practice run by Farrukh Nauman, based in Linköping, Sweden.

I work as **AI Automation Lead / Change Manager, Principal Consultant, or AI Engineer** — depending on what the engagement needs. My focus areas are **enterprise data platforms** (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Snowpark), **AI coding-agent workflows**, and **time series / telemetry ML**, and I help organizations move from AI exploration to controlled implementation: prioritizing high-value automation, modernizing data and code stacks, integrating agents into existing workflows, upgrading legacy code, and steering stakeholders across business, IT, data, legal/compliance, and security.

Since August 2025 I've been consulting through InertialRange Labs AB. As part of an ongoing engagement, I serve as **interim team lead for Data Science & Advanced Analytics** (Sep 2025 – Jun 2026) at a global industrial manufacturer, leading a 4–7 person team across telemetry analytics, ML, and GenAI automation — owning the roadmap, stakeholder steering, and technical direction.

Before InertialRange, I held AI researcher and consultant roles at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden (Jul 2021 – Aug 2025), where I led a Vinnova-funded applied AI project on circular fashion (**project lead, ~9M SEK**) and contributed as AI lead to the EU CISUTAC initiative (**~2M SEK**). Earlier, I held research positions at Chalmers University of Technology and the Niels Bohr Institute, and completed a PhD in Physics and Astronomy at the University of Rochester.

### Selected outcomes

- **~1 week**: cross-platform migration validator (Databricks → Snowflake), zero to live dashboard.
- **5–10× faster, 50%+ cheaper**: SQL pipeline optimization with row-level correctness validation.
- **10–100× faster**: time series classification for industrial telemetry and edge deployment.
- **40% faster** inspection workflows and **50%+ lower** data collection costs via synthetic data (circular-fashion computer vision).
- **Interim team lead** for a 4–7 person DS and advanced analytics team at a global industrial manufacturer.

See [selected work](https://fnauman.com/consulting.html) for worked case studies and [fnauman.com](https://fnauman.com) for writing.

## Why this company exists

Most AI and data-platform initiatives fail for predictable reasons: weak validation, underestimated data readiness, and a gap between prototypes and production. InertialRange exists to remove those failure modes with systematic evaluation, clear scope, and delivery-oriented execution.

Running my own company also lets me choose the right engagements — the ones where I can take real ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.
